user.title: Shared Energy Ledger
user.description: Configure cooperative energy accounting. You will be asked for the currency, the shared grid import meter, its per-kWh price sensor, optional PV and battery, and one screen per tenant.

data_description.currency: Three-letter currency code used as the unit of measurement for all monetary sensors.
data_description.import_energy_entity: A cumulative total-increasing sensor with unit_of_measurement kWh.
data_description.import_price_entity: A sensor reporting the effective grid import price per kWh in currency/kWh (for example EUR/kWh).

optional.title: Optional sections
optional.description: Choose which optional sources to configure. Each selected section adds one screen.

data.zero_cost: Price self-consumed PV at zero cost

data_description.energy_entity: Cumulative total-increasing kWh counter of PV generation.
data_description.zero_cost: When enabled, self-consumed PV energy is priced at zero and no PV price sensor is needed.
data_description.price_entity: Required unless zero-cost is selected. Reports the per-kWh value of self-consumed PV in currency/kWh (for example EUR/kWh).
data_description.power_entity: Optional; used for freshness and dashboards only.

data.power_entity: Battery signed DC power (W, negative on discharge)

data_description.charge_energy_entity: Cumulative total-increasing kWh counter of energy charged into the battery.
data_description.discharge_energy_entity: Cumulative total-increasing kWh counter of energy discharged from the battery.
data_description.power_entity: Signed DC power in W. Negative values indicate discharge.
data_description.charge_efficiency: Round-trip charge efficiency. Values below 50 % or above 100 % are rejected.
data_description.discharge_efficiency: Round-trip discharge efficiency. Values below 50 % or above 100 % are rejected.

data_description.energy_entity: Cumulative kWh boundary meter enabling the residual_of_total_minus_others allocation policy.
data_description.power_entity: Optional; reported alongside the energy boundary.

tenant.title: Add a tenant
tenant.description: Tenant {count} added so far. Enter this tenant's details. Keep 'Add another' ticked until every tenant is entered (minimum two).

data.name: Display name
data.add_another: Add another tenant after this one

data_description.slug: Lowercase kebab-case label, e.g. flat-3. Editable later without breaking entities.
data_description.name: Human-visible name shown on the dashboard.
data_description.allocation_policy: How this tenant's accounting energy is computed.
data_description.energy_entity: Cumulative energy sensor (kWh). Required for the direct-meter and proportional policies.
data_description.power_entity: Optional instantaneous power sensor (W), used for freshness only.

error.invalid_currency: Invalid currency code. Use an ISO 4217 three-letter code.
error.invalid_slug: Slugs must be lowercase, ASCII, and kebab-case.
error.invalid_entity: The selected entity does not exist or has an incompatible device class.
error.invalid_unit: The selected entity's unit_of_measurement does not match the expected unit.
error.pv_price_required: Select a PV price sensor or tick 'Price self-consumed PV at zero cost'.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single Shared Energy Ledger instance can be configured per Home Assistant install.

init.title: Shared Energy Ledger options
init.description: Add, edit, remove, or reorder tenants, attach shared loads, or adjust freshness windows.

shared_load.title: Shared load owner
shared_load.description: Pick the tenant that financially owns the shared load.

shared_load_details.title: Shared load for {owner}
shared_load_details.description: Configure a load owned by {owner}. Set the host tenant when the load is physically on another tenant's meter; leave host empty for a dedicated meter.

data_description.label: Short name shown in diagnostics and reports.
data_description.energy_entity: Cumulative kWh counter for this shared load.
data_description.host_slug: Tenant whose direct meter physically includes this load. Leave empty when the load has its own dedicated meter.

add_tenant.title: Add a tenant
add_tenant.description: Add a new tenant to the cooperative. A stable internal id is generated automatically; the slug is only a display label.

data_description.name: Human-visible name shown on the dashboard.
data_description.allocation_policy: How this tenant's accounting energy is computed.

edit_tenant_details.title: Edit tenant {slug}
edit_tenant_details.description: Update the display name, allocation policy, or meters for tenant {slug}. The internal id and entity unique_ids stay stable.

remove_tenant.title: Remove a tenant
remove_tenant.description: Pick a tenant to remove. At least two tenants must remain configured.

reorder.title: Reorder tenants
reorder.description: Select every tenant in the desired display order.

freshness.title: Freshness windows
freshness.description: Maximum accepted age (in seconds) for each data class before the corresponding freshness gate flips to off and dependent cost sensors go unavailable.

error.invalid_slug: Slugs must be lowercase, ASCII, and kebab-case.
error.duplicate_slug: That slug is already in use.

abort.no_tenants: There are no tenants to edit.
abort.unknown_tenant: That tenant no longer exists; the action was aborted.
abort.minimum_tenants: At least two tenants must remain; add a tenant before removing one.
abort.reorder_incomplete: The reorder must include every tenant exactly once.

rebuild_period_report.name: Rebuild period report
rebuild_period_report.description: Rebuild a deterministic Recorder-based JSON report for the given period, recomputed from meter and price history.

start.name: Start (local)
start.description: Local start of the reporting period.

end.name: End (local)
end.description: Local end of the reporting period.

tenant.name: Tenant (optional)
tenant.description: Restrict the report to a single tenant slug.

reset_battery_ledger.name: Reset battery ledger
reset_battery_ledger.description: Reset the priced battery stock to the given values. Requires admin permissions.

stock_cost.name: Stock cost
stock_cost.description: Cost of the new priced stock in the configured currency.

config_invalid.title: Configuration is invalid
config_invalid.description: Shared Energy Ledger rejected the current configuration: {reason}. Open the integration and reconfigure it. Until then, cost sensors remain unavailable per invariant I1.

ledger_boundary_incoherent.title: Battery ledger is incoherent
ledger_boundary_incoherent.description: The persisted battery ledger boundary pair (stock_kwh, stock_cost) is not coherent per invariant I6. Reset it via the `shared_energy_ledger.reset_battery_ledger` service with a valid pair.

upstream_missing.title: Upstream sensor is missing
upstream_missing.description: The configured sensor {resource} is not present in Home Assistant. Reconfigure the integration to point at the current entity.
